description: Gives an unpaid hold up at once (nothing was charged), or cancels a confirmed booking with a refundable rate; the refund follows the rate terms and goes back to the card through Nuitee. Non-refundable rates cannot be cancelled online. Only call this when the guest asked for it. Needs the booking_secret; with the key that made it, the guest email works too.

guest_email.description: With the key that made the booking: the guest email used for it.

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel booking
